Presentation canvas only; no webpage navigation, device frame, fake testimonials, customer counts, awards, or extra text. Generous margins, strong optical alignment, huge title, high contrast body text. Footnotes must still be readable. This is slide artwork, not an actual app screenshot. Render supplied text verbatim, including minus and plus signs. Use a warm white background. Main headline top-left in near-black: 'A $12,000 offer can leave a family with less'. Supporting sentence below, medium: 'Higher income can wipe out a household’s health-insurance subsidy.' On the right, a confident slightly tilted white offer sheet held between one elegant chrome fold, containing only 'Client offer' and '$12,000'. Below/left, make the large navy-black number '−$3,616' the main consequence, with label 'Extra household cash if accepted as written'. A small but clear profile line beside the headline: 'Independent professional. Tennessee. Family Marketplace coverage.' Then a source line 'IRS premium tax credit rules; Headroom decision case 1'. Do not make a bar chart, dashboard, a grid of cards or repeat the cover chrome H. One large offer, one financial consequence, plenty of whitespace. The minus sign is essential.
